name: Player
description: API for interacting with players.

functions.name: getConnecting
description: Returns a list of players who are currently connecting, but are not yet connected.
See the `"connecting"` event for more details.

functions.name: getConnected
description: Returns a list of players who are currently connected.
See the `"connected"` event for more details.

functions.name: isConnecting
description: Returns whether the given player is currently connecting, but not yet connected.
See the `"connecting"` event for more details.

returns.name: isConnecting
returns.description: True if the player is connecting.

functions.name: isConnected
description: Returns whether the given player is currently connected.
See the `"connected"` event for more details.

returns.name: isConnected
returns.description: True if the player is connected.

functions.name: getEntity
description: Returns the replicated entity representing this player, or `nil` if not yet initialised.
You should use this for replicating information about the player (e.g. position) across the network.
Note that unlike regular entities, when the player entity is deleted it _does not_ delete its children.
You must clean up any child entities on disconnect by hand.

parameters.name: player
parameters.description: Player to get the entity of.

functions.name: getId
description: Returns the unique ID for this player (their SteamID 64 on Steamworks-enabled builds of TASBox).
You should use this when determining if two players are the same,
as the player userdata objects passed to the scripting environment are always a new instance (and thus won't be equal).

parameters.name: player
parameters.description: Player to get the ID of.

functions.name: getName
description: Returns the display name for this player
**Do not** use this as a unique identifier for a player.
A player may change their username at any time, and two or more players could have the same display name.

parameters.name: player
parameters.description: Player to get the name of.

returns.name: name
returns.description: The player's display name, or `nil` if they haven't started/finished connecting.

functions.name: isLocalPlayer
functions.description: Returns whether the given player is the local player.

returns.name: isLocalPlayer
returns.description: True if the player is the local player.

functions.name: kick
functions.description: Kicks the player from the server if they were connecting or connected.

events.name: connecting
events.description: Fired when a player first starts connecting to the server, but before they've authenticated.

events.name: connected
events.description: Fired when a player finishes connecting to the server, after they've successfully authenticated.

events.name: disconnected
description: Fired when a player disconnects - or is disconnected from - the server.
This includes players who started connecting but didn't finish.
Don't assume you previously received a `"connected"` event for a player
when you receive a `"disconnected"` event for that player!
